messages:
Camila Reyes: Kicking off the public Latency/$ Benchmark Report launch coordination thread for #marketing. Goal: align owners + timeline + key links so we don’t lose track. Ben is campaign owner.

Camila Reyes: Primary doc links:
• Launch checklist + owners (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/RI-GTM-Benchmark-Launch (see “launch-checklist-and-owners”)
• PM scope + success metrics (Linear): https://linear.app/redwood/issue/PM-418-benchmark-report-scope-and-success-metrics
• Report outline (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/RI-GTM-Benchmark-Report (benchmark-report-draft-outline)

Ben Carter: Thanks. For quick context: we’re treating this like a 6–8 week sprint w/ a firm launch week. I’ll keep the checklist updated + chase deps.

Ben Carter: Proposed working launch date: Tue Apr 16 (gives us 7 weeks). If perf/Evals needs more runway we can slide, but we need a target for web + lifecycle.

Talia Benson: +1 on having a date even if it’s “aspirational.” I can run weekly cross-func check-ins. Suggest: Thu 10:00 PT for 30 min.

Soojin Lee: From messaging side: I’ll own “one-liner”, key narrative, and do/don’t language (esp around claims + variance). I’ll sync w/ Legal + Applied ML before anything is final.

Ethan Wallace: I’ll take report narrative lead (PDF + blog draft v1). I’ll start from the outline and drop a V0 by next Fri for async comments.

Tessa Morgan: Design: I can scope the visual system for charts + PDF/web consistency. Need chart inventory + the final list of which metrics are “front page”.

Jonas Weber: Applied ML/Methodology: we can commit to methodology draft by end of next week. We also need to agree on which regions/models are “must include” vs “nice to have” (capacity constraints).

Claire Dubois: For expectations: benchmark execution is the long pole, not the math. We’ll need reserved windows per region + rerun policy agreed early so we’re not relitigating later.

Ben Carter: Great. For owners (marketing side) I have:
• Landing page wirecopy + SEO: Ben + Elliot
• Report PDF narrative + findings: Ethan
• Messaging/claims guardrails: Soojin
• Lifecycle email sequence: Ben + Tyler
• Social pack: Ben (inputs from Soojin)
• Press/analyst pack: Camila (w/ Ethan)
• Field enablement coordination: Jordan (Sales) but we’ll support w/ source-of-truth doc

Elliot Price: Web/docs: if we want Apr 16, we need copy lock ~2 weeks prior for QA + translations (if any). Also need a decision on where the methodology appendix lives (docs vs PDF only).

Camila Reyes: For now: methodology appendix will live in docs and be linked from the landing page + PDF. Keeps it credible + easier to update.

Tyler Benson: Re: lifecycle + attribution. Please use the UTM plan template in the checklist. I’ll set up:
1) Report download event tracking
2) “Book a consult” conversion
3) Split between PLG (signup) vs sales meeting request

Sean Gallagher: SRE note: please don’t promise “weekly refresh” externally unless we mean it. Capacity windows are doable for launch, but recurring cadence needs planning.

Ben Carter: +1. We’ll message “initial release” + “quarterly refresh target” pending results. No hard commitment in external copy.

Jordan Blake: Sales asked for two things:
1) A simple talk track for “latency per dollar” (engineer + procurement versions)
2) A clear FAQ for “why does my mileage vary?” (regions, routing, workload mismatch)
If we can get those in the enablement packet, field will actually use it.

Soojin Lee: I’ll draft the talk tracks + FAQ framing. Will also add a short “how to interpret charts” section. Need inputs from Claire/Jonas on acceptable caveats language.

Rina Kobayashi: FYI on data: we can share aggregate tables publicly but not raw logs. We’ll provide sanitized “public table generator” output to marketing.

Camila Reyes: Action items (this week):
• Ben: update checklist with Apr 16 target + owner columns (today)
• Talia: send recurring meeting invite (by EOD)
• Ethan: V0 report copy plan + sections (by Fri)
• Soojin: messaging skeleton + claims guardrails (by Fri)
• Jonas/Claire: confirm initial coverage (models/regions/workloads) + timeline risks (by next Tue)

Ben Carter: Done — checklist updated w/ proposed milestones. Calling out key gates:
- Scope lock: Mar 5
- First benchmark results + QC notes: Mar 22
- Copy lock (landing page + PDF): Apr 2
- Web QA + final assets: Apr 9
- Launch: Apr 16

Tessa Morgan: That timeline works if we get chart specs early. Ethan/Ben: can you tag me when the chart spec doc is ready? I need it to design templates.

Ethan Wallace: Yes. I’ll stub chart placeholders in the report V0 and link to the chart spec doc as soon as I get it from Applied ML.

Claire Dubois: One more ask: please route any “headline stats” ideas through methodology review before they’re used in social/PR. It’s easy to accidentally overclaim if we pick the best model/region combo.

Camila Reyes: 100%. We’ll have a “claims checklist” gate before anything goes out. I’ll also ensure Legal (Michael) sees the final PR/blog.

Talia Benson: Invites going out for Thu 10:00 PT benchmark launch standup. Agenda: scope lock, blockers, next deliverables, launch readiness.

Ben Carter: Adding the recurring link to the checklist now.

Elliot Price: Quick web note: please keep the hero copy simple + engineer-forward. If we can get 1 clear CTA (“Download report”) + 1 secondary (“Try it on your workload”), that’s the cleanest.

Soojin Lee: Agree. I’ll propose 3 hero variants in the messaging doc and we can pick one in next standup.

Tyler Benson: Also: please don’t create new shortlinks in random docs. Put final URLs in the checklist so we don’t break UTMs at launch.

Camila Reyes: Perfect. Keeping this thread as the “single source of truth” pointer, but all execution tracking stays in the Drive checklist + Linear.

Ben Carter: Last thing: if anyone needs access to the Drive folders and gets permission errors, ping me + I’ll add.

Camila Reyes: Thanks all. Let’s keep replies here for coordination and drop doc links as they solidify.
